outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Spondon is a neighbourhood ward located within Derby. Community matters and local improvements are overseen by a Neighbourhood Board, which comprises local councillors, residents, and representatives from public services and community organisations. The ward boasts several popular local landmarks and open spaces, such as Borrow Wood Park, Dale Road Park, and the scenic West Park Meadow Nature Reserve. In addition, Spondon Library serves as a vital public community facility for local residents.

Healthcare provision within the area is centered around key medical facilities delivering essential NHS services. NHS general practice services in Spondon are provided from Chapel Street Medical Centre. Additionally, general practice services are delivered from Central Health Network and Central Occupational Health, forming an integral part of the primary medical care network available across the ward.

Pharmacy First provides another way for eligible patients to seek help for certain common health conditions. A pharmacist can assess symptoms, consider relevant medicines and medical history, and explain the most appropriate next step. Depending on the clinical assessment, this may include advice, suitable treatment or referral to another healthcare professional.
